title: map_size_gb has no upper-bound validation; overflow on misconfigured value
description: lmdb/src/lib.rs:63: map_size_gb as usize * 1024 * 1024 * 1024. An operator who writes map_size_gb = 20000 (20 TiB) would produce a usize that wraps in debug builds (panic) or wraps silently in release builds on a 64-bit machine, setting LMDB's map to a nonsensical value. Default is 1024 (fine), but there is no config validation that rejects values exceeding platform limits. Add a check: map_size_gb must be > 0 and map_size_gb * 1024^3 must not overflow usize (i.e. map_size_gb <= usize::MAX / (1024*1024*1024)).
